_what: Single shared configuration for the news pipeline. Every stage reads this file; no stage defines its own dates.

frozen_holdout.purpose: Stage 4 (end-to-end combination) only. Stages 1-3 must never load a LABEL (any realised price after decide_at) for a holdout day. Enforced in code by pipeline.config.assert_no_holdout_labels().
eligibility: a trading day on or after `start`

the Toss per-company universe news for that day is collected for every top-300 code (the SAME construction as stage 1: news_master_prior over data/toss_universe_42m); the kr_quant news_articles dashboard feed does NOT qualify -- different population, different text
top-300 minute-bar coverage >= 0.95 of codes with >= 300 regular-session bars (the relaxed usable rule)
frozen_holdout.stage4_rule: stage 4 waits until at least target_trading_days eligible days exist; it is then run once
frozen_holdout.status_2026-09-23: minute bars are complete for 2026-09-16..09-21 (~1,765 codes/day). The Toss universe archive ends 2026-09-17 17:53 and NO collector is running, so eligible forward days = 09-16 only (09-17 partial). Stage 4 cannot become ready until the universe news collection is resumed and run every trading day.
frozen_holdout.exposure_history: No selection, timing or exit model has been scored on these days. Two pooled, model-free measurements touched the start of the window: the hourly matched-null confirm (2026-03-27..09-21, news pairs on 09-16/09-17 only) and the daily HMM / leg-decomposition confirm (universe-level, through 09-21).

stage1.population: news_master_prior construction: every (article, code) with code in that day's top-300 universe, published in [08:00, 15:20) KST, decide_at = published_at + 4 min, pre-09:00 clamped to 09:00; priced by prompt_labels.py
stage1.text: title + summary exactly as the live judge receives them (build_prompt in infrastructure/external/anthropic_client.py); never the article body
stage1.oof: expanding-window forward chaining by calendar month: each month is scored by a model fitted only on earlier months; the first months are burn-in and carry no score
stage1.primary_metric: mean within-day Spearman IC between score and realised target, day-clustered SE; pre-registered before any model is fitted
stage1.noise_control: identical search re-run on targets permuted within day; report best-of-N on noise beside every candidate
stage1.confirm_rule: Arm, feature set and hyperparameters are chosen ONLY on out-of-fold performance in selection_range. The chosen configuration's forward out-of-fold scores on confirm_range (each month scored by a model fitted only on earlier months) are then read ONCE. Frozen before any stage-1 code existed. track_a_prior (2026-01-28..2026-03-16) is spent as a confirm window and is ordinary training data here.
stage1.post_train_note: Rows here are scored by the final stage-1 model (trained_through = train_range end), from decision-time features only, with split 'post_train'. Those scores are valid out-of-fold for stages 2-3. Labels may be built here for stage 2-3 fitting (consumed window, see consumed_windows).
stage1.refit_before_stage4: The current stage-1 artifact is trained through 2026-07-31. Before stage 4 runs, refit the final model on everything through 2026-09-15 so the forward holdout is scored by a model that saw all non-holdout data. Selection and confirm have already been read; the refit does not re-choose the configuration.

consumed_windows.was: the first stage-4 holdout, adopted from rl-exit-v2 d55dd90 and frozen at c76532a
consumed_windows.consumed_by: rl-exit-v2 neural and tabular exit policies scored with --confirm on 2026-09-22 23:29..23:54 (data/eval/exitseq/seqexit_nn_*.json, seqexit_table_fresh.json; docs/research/2026-09-22-neural-exit-rl.md)
consumed_windows.earlier_exposure: 2026-08-03..08-18 lay in the search windows of the breadth search and the persistence test; 2026-08-19..09-15 was their confirm slice
consumed_windows.use_in_stages_1_3: ALLOWED for fitting and search, NEVER as evidence. A consumed window loses its value as an evaluation: a result read there is no longer independent of choices already made on it. Fitting on it costs nothing an evaluation needs, provided every claim is evaluated on the forward holdout, which it does not overlap. So stages 1-3 may train and tune on it; no stage may report a number from it as a confirm or out-of-sample result.

consumed_windows.consumed_by: scored twice (unweighted V1 and WLS V2 entry bandits)
stage 1 read once for the pre-chosen configuration (tfidf_num / mfe_n), 2c4d19d
consumed_windows.use_in_stages_1_3: ordinary training data from now on
